text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
campus...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Dang it! I can't... reach!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is repeatedly jumping and
grabbing
at a flyer that's caught on a
tree branch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What are you looking at? Don't you
have better
things to do than stare at
people like a weirdo?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you mocking me or
something? I got
this, so just leave me
alone.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: At least let me cheer you on!

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you mocking me or
something? I got
this, so just leave me
alone.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: At least let me cheer you on!

text_block_list.text: Shut up! I don't need any of that!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She shuts down every offer I make, so I
resort to
secretly watching over her to
make sure she
doesn't injure herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get this thing no matter
what!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her unparalleled stamina,
Narita
Taishin continues to jump at the
flyer for what
seems like forever until at
last...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: HAH! Gotcha!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, victory at last. Am I good, or
what?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Whatever! Fine!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I don't have the energy to deal with you.
If you
want to help, then hurry up and
do something!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Together, we look for things to stand on
so we
can pull down the branches and
reach the flyer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, I should be able to get it now...
Hup!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her powerful legs, we're
finally able to
get the flyer down!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh. That was too much work for what
it's worth...
But...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You were more helpful than I thought
you'd be. I
was sure you'd be useless.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
There are so many things I can learn
from the way
Нарита Таисин utilizes her
body, especially her leg
strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This just goes to show that you can reach
any
goal as long as you never give up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
